name: Accordion · support topics
description: White cards with icons in two columns for support topics.

data.heading: Browse help topics
data.subheading: Find a guide, or contact us if you cannot see what you need.

items.question: Logging in
items.answer: Reset your password from the sign-in page. If you are locked out, contact support to verify your identity.

items.question: Billing
items.answer: Update your card, download invoices and change plans from Settings, then Billing.

items.question: Importing data
items.answer: Upload a CSV or connect an existing tool. Imports of up to 100,000 rows take a few minutes.

items.question: Teams and roles
items.answer: Invite colleagues and choose between admin, editor and viewer permissions.
